nodes.name: Next-attempt webhook
nodes.notes: Meant to be called right after post-call-synthesis.workflow.json produces a Disposition, to decide what happens to this record's HopperEntry next. Input contract: {hopperEntryId, opportunityId, disposition, attemptCountThisWave, wave (1-4), lastAttemptDate, repId}. hopperEntryId + repId are new this pass (CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md's HopperEntry object) - repId is who just took the call, needed so a Callback locks to the right rep.

nodes.name: Apply attempt matrix
nodes.notes: The one workflow in this library with real, brief-specified business logic encoded directly (not a placeholder) - the attempt caps and wave count are given numbers, not invented. Every branch now also decides the HopperEntry's next state (hopperStatus/claimedByRepId/nextOwner) alongside the original human-readable action, since 'Write HopperEntry state' (below) needs a decision to persist, not just a decision to report back to the caller.

nodes.name: Write HopperEntry state

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: $json.hopperStatus, claimedByRepId: $json.claimedByRepId, disposition: $('Next-attempt webhook').item.json.body.disposition, attemptCountThisWave: $('Next-attempt webhook').item.json.body.attemptCountThisWave, wave: $json.nextWave || $('Next-attempt webhook').item.json.body.wave, lastAttemptDate: $('Next-attempt webhook').item.json.body.lastAttemptDate, nextEligibleAt: $json.eligibleFrom || null }) }}

nodes.notes: NEW this pass - previously this workflow only computed a decision and responded with it, it never persisted anything, because HopperEntry didn't exist as an object until this pass (CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md). Skipped entirely for the REVIEW action's hopperStatus: null case below via the IF node, since there's nothing decided yet to write - a human needs to look at it first, and the entry stays exactly as claimed/Claimed in the meantime rather than being touched.

nodes.name: Needs a write?
nodes.notes: REVIEW (unrecognized disposition) sets hopperStatus: null on purpose - nothing safe to write yet, needs a human look first. Everything else always has a real hopperStatus to persist.
